library.emptyDesc: The first one shows up here once you’ve recorded.
library.noHitsDesc: The search looks at the date, the file name and the note.
library.trashLede: Recordings here are deleted for good after {n} days.
library.trashEmptyDesc: Recordings you delete land here first.

record.noSource: You haven’t chosen a sound source
record.noSourceDesc: Choose the mixing desk — or the computer’s own microphone if that’s what you use.
record.whyBlocked: Start is blocked until a sound source is chosen. We never record from a source nobody picked.
record.canStart: You can start anyway — the recording stays silent until the mixing desk is back.
record.startHint: The space bar starts the recording.

camera.noneFound: No cameras found — check the connection
camera.listFailed: Could not get the camera list — check permissions
camera.pickFirst: Choose a camera to see the picture
camera.denied: Camera access denied — check System Settings
camera.noResponse: Camera not responding — is another app using it?

record.sourceChipTitle: Sound source, folder and recording options

sound.lede: Choose the sound source you record from, and check that we hear it.
sound.goneDesc: Check that it is on and the cable is in.
sound.noneDesc: We never record from a sound source nobody chose.
sound.builtInDesc: For trying things out only, or if you have no mixing desk.
sound.whichChannels: Which inputs on the mixing desk?
sound.channelHint: Pick the pair carrying the sound you want to record — one input for left, one for right. The ones with sound right now light up.
sound.testHint: Speak into the microphone or play something.
sound.emptyDesc: Not even the computer’s own microphone. Check access under System Settings → Privacy.

folder.lede: Recordings are placed in this folder on the computer.
folder.label: Saved to
folder.unknownSpace: We don’t know how much space is left here.
folder.noneDesc: Choose a folder on this computer. Without it the app can’t record.
folder.refusedPackage: That folder is an app or a package (like a Keynote or Logic project), not an ordinary folder. Choose another folder.
folder.refusedTooBroad: Choose a folder inside your home folder, for example “SundayRec” in Documents – not the home folder itself or the root of the disk.
folder.refusedProtected: That folder is protected and can’t be used for recordings. Choose another folder.
folder.refusedAppData: That folder is the app’s own data folder, or is inside it, and can’t be used for recordings. Choose another folder.
folder.refusedInvalid: That folder can’t be used for recordings. Choose another folder.

qDesc.mp3: Good for the web and sharing. About 1 GB per 10 hours · MP3
qDesc.flac: Everything that came in, with nothing lost. About 5 GB per 10 hours · FLAC
qDesc.wav: Uncompressed, the way an archive should be. About 10 GB per 10 hours · WAV

notify.lede: The computer always tells you when something goes wrong — whoever is at it.
notify.osDesc: When a scheduled recording starts and stops. Failures are always shown.
notify.remindDesc: So someone has time to turn on the mixing desk.
notify.permissionGranted: On — SundayRec can tell you here.
notify.permissionUnknown: Can't be read on this computer. Send a test notification to see that they come through.
notify.permissionDeniedError: Nobody sees the failure notifications until notifications are turned back on.
notify.testSent: The test notification was sent. If it didn't appear, open the settings and turn on notifications for SundayRec.
notify.testSentDenied: The test notification was sent, but notifications are off — it won't show until they're turned on.
notify.testFailed: The test notification could not be sent.
notify.openSettingsFailed: Couldn't open the notification settings. Open them from the system settings.

camera.keepAudioDesc: A plain audio file next to the video.
camera.probeFailed: We could not read what the camera can do. The recording uses the best the camera actually delivers, up to Full HD.
camera.noneDesc: Connect a camera, or turn off “Include video”.

auto.title: Record automatically
auto.desc: Add the times in the week below. The computer wakes and starts on its own.
auto.launchDesc: Without this the recording won’t start after a restart.

advanced.diagDesc: Never audio, names or files. You can see exactly what is sent.
advanced.diagPreviewNext: This is exactly what will be sent next time.
advanced.diagPreviewHistory: Usage statistics are off. This shows what the data would look like, taken from your own history on this computer — nothing is sent.
advanced.diagDeleteBody: Statistics not yet sent are cleared. SundayRec then asks for everything already sent from this computer to be deleted. The computer gets a new anonymous number, so new figures cannot be linked to the old ones.
advanced.diagDeleted: The data is cleared, and the computer has a new anonymous number.
advanced.diagDeleteFailed: Could not delete the data. Try again.
advanced.updateDesc: “Regular” is recommended. “Try new things first” gives you new versions before they are well tested.
advanced.autoUpdateDesc: Checks every hour whether a newer version exists. Nothing is downloaded until you say yes.
advanced.updateBetaBody: These versions reach you before they have been tried at a real service, and can contain faults that ruin a recording. Do not use this on the computer that records the service. You can switch back at any time.
advanced.updateReady: Version {v} is downloaded — restart to start using it
advanced.updateRestartFailed: The restart did not happen. Quit the app and open it again, and the update is active.
advanced.updateBusyRecording: Cannot update while a recording is running
advanced.logDesc: A file showing what the app has done, and any errors. It helps whoever is troubleshooting. No audio and no passwords.
advanced.logShowFailed: Could not open the folder with the error log.
advanced.logEmpty: The error log is still empty.
advanced.logCopyFailed: Could not copy the error log.
advanced.licensesDesc: The software from others that SundayRec is built on, and ffmpeg (GPL) with where its source code is.
advanced.licensesFailed: The license text could not be found. Try reinstalling the app.
advanced.wakeTestBlocked: Not while a recording is running.
advanced.autoDeleteConfirmBody: Recordings older than this are moved to the trash. Under 30 days can mean a service is gone before anyone has downloaded it.

wakeWord.can: This machine can be woken from sleep.
wakeWord.cannot: This machine cannot be woken from sleep — leave it switched on.
wakeWord.needsAdmin: This machine can be woken, but asks for an administrator password the first time.
wakeWord.unknown: We do not know yet whether this machine can be woken.

wakeIssue.macArmNoPowerOn: This Mac cannot turn itself on from fully off — it has to be asleep.
wakeIssue.macIntelManualPowerOn: This Mac can turn itself on from off, but you have to switch on “Start up or wake” yourself in System Settings → Battery.
wakeIssue.winTimerDiesWithApp: SundayRec sets up the wake-up while the program is running. If you quit SundayRec completely, it disappears.
wakeIssue.winS5NeedsBios: For the computer to wake from fully off, this must be switched on in its startup settings (BIOS). SundayRec cannot do that for you — leave the computer asleep instead.
wakeIssue.linuxUnsupported: Automatic wake-up does not work on Linux.
wakeIssue.platformUnsupported: Automatic wake-up does not work on this type of computer.

wakeAdvice.macKeepAsleep: Leave the computer asleep — do not shut it down.
wakeAdvice.macDisableStandby: Turn off “deep sleep” (standby) in the energy settings — otherwise the computer may not wake up.
wakeAdvice.macStayPluggedIn: Keep the computer plugged in — a Mac does not wake reliably on battery.
wakeAdvice.winKeepAppRunning: Keep SundayRec running — it starts by itself when you sign in and sits in the system tray by the clock.
wakeAdvice.winSleepNotShutdown: Put the computer to sleep, do not shut it down.
wakeAdvice.winStayPluggedIn: Keep the computer plugged in — many laptops will not wake on battery.
wakeAdvice.winCheckBios: If the trial wake-up does not work: check that “Allow wake timers” is on in the power settings, and that “Wake on RTC” is on in the BIOS.
wakeAdvice.useMacOrWindows: Automatic wake-up only works on Mac and Windows.

wakeArmWord.idle: Put the wake-up into the computer now. May ask for an administrator password.
wakeArmWord.ok: The wake-up has been set up in the computer.
wakeArmWord.autoRecordOff: No wake-ups to set up — “Record automatically” is off.
wakeArmWord.nothingUpcoming: No wake-ups to set up — nothing is scheduled ahead.
wakeArmWord.needsAdmin: Needs an administrator password — try again and answer the prompt.
wakeArmWord.disabled: Turn on “Wake the machine from sleep” first.
wakeArmWord.unsupported: This machine cannot be woken by the app.
wakeArmWord.cancelled: You cancelled — nothing was set up.
wakeArmWord.failed: The wake-up was not set up.

advanced.wakeTestIdle: Schedule a real wake-up two minutes from now, and see whether the machine actually wakes.
advanced.wakeTestScheduled: Scheduled for {time} — let the machine sleep to see whether it wakes.

wakeHistoryReason.noResume: the computer did not wake up

advanced.audioTechNote: The text below is a licence notice from Steinberg and is shown in English.
advanced.prerollDesc: The app listens in the background, so the seconds before you press Start are not lost. The microphone stays open for as long as the app is ready to record.

sections.recordingDesc: How the recording itself should work: sound from before Start, stopping on silence, maximum length, splitting into several files and deleting old recordings.
sections.updatesDesc: You decide whether the app checks for new versions.
sections.aboutDesc: Licenses and notices for the software SundayRec is built on.
sections.cameraDesc: Include video from a camera along with the sound.
sections.privacyDesc: You decide whether the app sends anonymous statistics.

first.gate: Choose a sound source and press “Use this sound source”. “Next” opens once we hear sound.
first.gateReason: We don’t hear any sound yet. Speak into the microphone, or turn on the mixing desk.
first.planLede: Add the time SundayRec should record by itself every week. Drag in the week to add a recording. To wait, choose “Later” — you will find it again under Plan.

consent.title: Want to help make SundayRec better?
consent.desc: Anonymous numbers about what works and what fails. Never audio, names or files.

overlay.closeHint: You can close the window — recording continues in the background.
overlay.stopQuestionDesc: {elapsed} recorded so far. If you stop now, what you have is saved.
overlay.reconnect: Sound from {name} disappeared — trying to reconnect
overlay.reconnectAnon: The sound disappeared — trying to reconnect
overlay.videoSkipped: The camera is falling a little behind, so a few frames were skipped. The audio is not affected.
overlay.cameraLost: The camera dropped out — the audio is still being recorded
overlay.videoStopped: The picture stopped — the audio is still being recorded
overlay.cameraNotOpened: The camera did not open — the audio is being recorded without a picture
overlay.finalizingHint: The recording is being written to disk. It takes a few seconds, and the file is safe meanwhile.

done.title: Recording saved
done.revealFailed: Couldn’t find the file on disk.

editor.loadFailedDesc: The format may not be supported, or the file is damaged.
editor.loadNotFoundDesc: It may be in the trash.
editor.listenAria: Hear the sound before or after the improvement
editor.sample: {at} — from the middle of what is kept
editor.listenPreparing: Getting the listening ready – the first time takes a little while …
editor.listenFailed: Could not start the listening. The export still runs.
editor.listenStopped: The listening was stopped because a recording started.

fmtDesc.mp3: Small file. Good for the web and sharing.
fmtDesc.flac: Same quality as the recording, smaller file.

editor.includeVideoDesc: The recording has a video track. Without this the export is audio only.
editor.videoLocksFormat: The format is MP4 while the video is included.
editor.jinglesDesc: Optional sound before and after the recording, such as a short tune. With "Podcast-ready audio" on it gets the same loudness as the speech.
editor.jinglePickLabel: Choose an audio file for the {which}
editor.jingleVideoNote: Intro and outro are not added when the video is included. Turn off "Include video (MP4)" to use them.
editor.levelCapped: Volume: a little lower than intended (loud peaks in the sound)
editor.podcastAudioDesc: Clearer voice, even levels and the right loudness for podcasts. The original is never touched.

deadChannel.left: The left side is silent — check the cable
deadChannel.right: The right side is silent — check the cable

export.contentDescriptionPlaceholder: Bible passage, theme or a line about the church
export.contentHint: All optional. If you write a title, the file is named after it — that is what SoundCloud and similar sites suggest when you upload.
export.title: Export

banner.diskDesc: The recording stops when the disk is full. Free up space before Sunday.
banner.missedDesc: The computer was off. Automatic recording needs it on or asleep.
banner.missedHelp: Leave the computer on, or let it sleep — SundayRec wakes it ten minutes before the recording. If it is switched off completely, nothing can start it. Also check that “Start automatically with the computer” is on in the “Record automatically” card on the Record page, so the app is running again after a restart.

plan.gridLabel: Weekly plan of fixed recordings, Monday to Sunday
plan.empty: No fixed times yet. Drag in the week to add a recording.
plan.off: Automatic recording is off. The times stay in the week, but nothing starts on its own.
plan.keys: Times repeat every week. Drag on an empty area to add a recording, drag a block to move it, and drag an edge to change the start or end. With the keyboard: Enter opens, arrow keys move (Shift + up/down changes the length), Delete removes.
plan.errOverlap: Overlaps {day} {range}. SundayRec can only record one thing at a time.
plan.errNoRoom: There is no room for a recording here. Try another time.
plan.errLength: A recording must last at least 15 minutes and less than a day.
plan.runningNote: The change applies from next time — the recording running now stops at {time}

strip.title: Weekly plan
strip.noneSub: Open and drag in the week to add a recording
strip.autoOffSub: The times are kept in the week — nothing starts by itself

tile.launchTitle: Start SundayRec when the computer starts
tile.wakeTitle: Wake the computer from sleep before a recording
tile.notifyTitle: Alert when a recording starts and stops

preflightCode.ffmpegMissing: The ffmpeg binary is missing. SundayRec must be installed again.
preflightCode.deviceMissing: The sound source selected in settings is not connected.
preflightCode.folderNotWritable: The save folder cannot be written to.
preflightCode.diskLow: Only {gb} GB free on the save disk — perhaps not enough for a whole recording.
preflightCode.micDenied: Microphone access has not been granted. Open System Settings → Privacy → Microphone.
preflightCode.cameraDenied: Camera access has not been granted.
preflightCode.saveFolderSynced: The save folder is synced by “OneDrive”, which can interfere with a recording in progress.

preflightErrors.one: {n} error to fix before the recording
preflightErrors.other: {n} errors to fix before the recording

preflightWarns.one: {n} thing to check before the recording
preflightWarns.other: {n} things to check before the recording

home.readyNoSchedule: Ready — set up a schedule to start recordings automatically
home.wakesNotArmed: The machine must be on or asleep when the recording starts — no wake-up has been confirmed.

retentionMoved.one: 1 old recording was moved to the trash
retentionMoved.other: {n} old recordings were moved to the trash

trash.title: Trash
trash.undoFailed: Could not bring everything back — check the trash.
trash.confirmEmptyBody: The files are deleted from disk. This cannot be undone.

error.tryAgainHint: If the problem persists, open Settings → Help and troubleshooting and get the error log, or restart the app.
error.ipcFailed: Something in the background did not respond, so this view may be incomplete.
error.settingsLoadFailed: Could not read the settings — showing defaults. Changes you make now may be lost.
error.recordingsFolderMissing: The recordings folder doesn’t exist yet. It is created when the first recording starts. If it is on an external disk, check that the disk is connected.

editor.title: Edit audio file
editor.emptyDesc: Pick an audio or video file to start editing. You can trim the start and end, or cut sections out of the middle.
editor.dragHint: Click and drag to mark a part to cut out
editor.normalizeHint: Adjusts the peak to -1 dBFS for a safe final mix.
editor.normalizeResult: Peak now at -1 dBFS — safe for export.
editor.normalizeAlready: The peak is already at -1 dBFS — no change needed.
editor.normalizeExportHint: Normalisation is heard on export, not while previewing.
editor.dropFile: Drop an audio or video file here
editor.emptyTitleDrop: Drop a file here — or click to open
editor.ioDragHint: — or drag a file onto the timeline
editor.jinglesVideoUnsupported: Jingles are not supported for video yet
editor.confirmClose: You have unsaved changes. Close anyway?
editor.confirmOpenOther: You have unsaved changes. Open a new file anyway?
editor.confirmExportRunning: The export is running. Cancel it?
editor.errNoAudioRemaining: No audio left — the cuts cover the entire recording. Remove at least one cut before exporting.
editor.errTimeout: Export took too long and was stopped. Try again, or split the file into smaller recordings.
editor.errFileNotFound: Original file is not available — is the disk disconnected?
editor.errDiskFull: The disk is full. Free up space and try again.
editor.errCutData: Internal error in cut data. Try reloading the file.
editor.qualityFallback: Playback is not available right now — the sound card could not be opened, or the file could not be read. Cutting and export work as usual.
editor.autoEnhanceFail: Could not analyze the audio (requires the editor build).
editor.errInvalidFormat: This format is not supported for export. Choose a different format on the Export page.
editor.errExportAlreadyRunning: An export is already running. Wait until it has finished.
editor.errDiskLowForExport: There is not enough free space for this export. Free up space, or pick another folder with “Choose folder…”.
editor.errExportFolderPickAgain: Choose the export folder again with “Choose folder…”.
editor.errExportFolderMissing: The folder you chose is no longer there — is the disk disconnected? Reconnect it, or pick another folder with “Choose folder…”.
editor.errExportFolderRefused: That folder cannot be used for an export. Pick another folder with “Choose folder…”.
editor.errSourceUnknown: The recording is no longer open. Open it again and export once more.
editor.errSourceRefused: That recording cannot be opened in the editor (it is in a protected folder). Open another file.
editor.errExportClipUnusable: The intro or outro sound is gone or cannot be used. Pick it again, or export without it.
editor.errClipRefused: That file cannot be used as an intro or outro (it is in a protected folder). Pick another.
editor.errClipMissing: The file you picked is no longer there. Pick it again.
editor.errRecordingInProgress: A recording is in progress. Wait until it has finished before you export.
editor.errPathNotAbsolute: Invalid folder or file path. Choose the destination folder again.

recording.deviceSubstituted: Recording from “{device}”, not the sound source you chose. Check that it is the right microphone.
recording.finalizingHint: One moment — the audio is being written to file.
recording.finalizeTimeout: The recording is taking unusually long to finish. Check that the file was saved.
recording.confirmBody: The recording will be saved up to this point.
recording.errorPermission: Microphone access denied — open System Settings and grant access
recording.errorDeviceNotFound: Sound source not found — check the USB connection
recording.errorNotReadable: The sound source is in use by another application
recording.errorDeviceError: Error opening the sound source — try reconnecting it
recording.errorAlreadyRecording: A recording is already in progress
recording.errorEmpty: The recording is empty — no audio reached the app from the sound source
recording.errorFolderPermission: No access to the save folder — make sure it's writable
recording.errorFolderError: Can't create the save folder — check disk space and permissions
recording.errorDeviceDisconnected: The sound source was disconnected during recording — check the connection
recording.errorDiskFull: The disk is full — free up space and try again
recording.errorFfmpegMissing: Internal error: the recording binary is missing — reinstall the app
recording.errorStuck: Recording stopped — no audio from the sound source for 60 seconds
recording.errorStartTimeout: The recording never got going — check that the microphone (and camera) are connected, and that SundayRec has access under System Settings → Privacy & Security
recording.errorEngineExited: The recording engine stopped unexpectedly — the audio up to that point is saved. Start a new recording, and get the error log (Settings → Help and troubleshooting) if it happens again.
recording.errorVideoCapture: The camera delivered no picture — the audio was saved and is in the library. Check the camera connection before recording with video again.
recording.errorCameraFormat: The camera does not support the chosen frame rate or resolution — pick another video setting and try again.
recording.errorCameraPermission: Camera access denied — open System Settings and give the app access to the camera
recording.errorCameraBusy: The camera is in use by another program — close it (Teams, Zoom) and try again
recording.errorMux: Audio and video could not be combined — both raw files were kept in the save folder, so nothing is lost.
recording.qualityAlarm: WARNING: The recording is missing audio — the file holds {m} of {e} seconds. Check the recording before trusting it.
recording.errorInvalidOpts: Invalid recording settings — restart and try again
recording.errorNoSaveFolder: No save folder has been chosen — go to the Record page and choose one in the “Where are recordings saved?” card
recording.errorUnknown: Something went wrong during recording — check that the sound source and save folder are ready
recording.silenceWarn: Silence detected — the recording will stop automatically if the silence continues.
recording.autostopFailed: Could not change the auto-stop. The recording continues — stop it manually if you need to.
recording.qrNoAudio: No audio was captured — the file is too small to hold anything.
recording.qrSilent: The recording is silent — no signal. Check the sound source and the gain.
recording.qrGapFail: Parts of the audio are missing or silent — stuttering or dropouts.
recording.qrDropsFail: Many dropouts from the sound source.
recording.qrSampleRate: The sample rate was forced away from the device's own — the conversion can cause dropouts.
recording.qrGapWarn: A small gap or silence in the recording.
recording.qrLowSignal: Weak signal — consider raising the gain.
recording.qrDropsWarn: A few dropouts from the sound source.

onboarding.promptDesc: SundayRec can send anonymous error and usage statistics to SundaySuite to improve the app. Optional, and you can answer any time under Settings → Updates and privacy.
onboarding.rePromptDesc: You have answered this before, but we are asking again to be sure your answer covers what is shared now: only anonymous counters and technical numbers about the recordings (whether audio dropped out, for how long, and what failed) — never audio, names, files or text. Your previous answer has not been assumed, neither as a yes nor as a no, and nothing is sent until you answer here.

dialog.discardEditsBody: The cuts you have made will be lost. The recording file itself is untouched.
dialog.abortExportBody: The file being created will not be finished. The recording file itself is untouched.

guard.title: {what} now?
guard.duringRecording: A recording is running right now. The change can interrupt or ruin what is being recorded.

beforeRecording.one: The next scheduled recording starts in {n} minute. The change will affect that recording.
beforeRecording.other: The next scheduled recording starts in {n} minutes. The change will affect that recording.

health.micDenied: Microphone access is denied. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone and enable SundayRec.
health.micRestricted: Microphone access is blocked by a system administrator or parental controls. Recording will not work until the block is lifted.
health.cameraDenied: Camera access is denied. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Camera and enable SundayRec.
health.cameraRestricted: Camera access is blocked by a system administrator or parental controls. Video recording will not work until the block is lifted.
health.ffmpegMissing: The recording engine (ffmpeg) was not found. Video, export and editing will not work — reinstall the app.

notify.prerollDead: “Include sound from before Start” is not working right now — sound from before you press Start is not being kept.
notify.recoverySkipped: An interrupted recording could not be fully recovered: {file}
notify.deviceMissing: The sound source “{device}” is not connected.
notify.diskLow: Disk space is running low — {freeGb} GB free. The recording will stop on its own if the disk fills up.
notify.trashManifestUnreadable: The trash listing could not be read. The files are still there, but the app no longer knows where they came from.
notify.dataDirMoveFailed: The history and settings could not be moved to the new folder. The app is using the old one this time, and nothing has been deleted. Your recording files are still in the recordings folder. Restart the app; if that does not help, get in touch.
notify.dataLeftInOldDir: History and settings from the older version were left in the old folder. This version uses the new folder, so what you saved with the older version is not shown here. Your recording files are still in the recordings folder.
notify.levelWeak: The recording is very quiet — is the mixing desk turned down?
notify.videoDropped: The recording is saved with its sound, but the picture is incomplete: a video file could not be read. The file is kept next to the recording ({file}).
